tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__dismiss_task
tools.description:
Withdraw a background-task chip you previously created with spawn_task.

Call this when a suggestion you flagged is now stale, superseded, or irrelevant — e.g. you (or the user) already fixed it in this session, or you spawned a better-scoped replacement. To replace a chip: call spawn_task with the new suggestion first, then dismiss the old task_id.

Only chips the user hasn't acted on can be withdrawn from the queue. If the user already started or dismissed the task, the result says so (a dismissed task's copy kept for later is withdrawn too) — do not retry.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__mark_chapter
tools.description:
Mark the start of a new chapter in this session.

Call this when the work shifts to a meaningfully different phase — e.g. after finishing exploration and starting implementation, after a fix lands and you move to verification, or when the user pivots to an unrelated request. The user sees a divider in the transcript and a floating table of contents for jumping between chapters.

Use sparingly: a chapter should cover a coherent stretch of work, not every tool call. A typical session has 3–8 chapters. Do not mark a chapter for the very first message — the session start is implicit.

The title is a short noun phrase ("Codebase exploration", "Auth bug fix", "Test verification"), not a sentence.

tools.name: mcp__ccd_session__spawn_task
tools.description:
Flag an out-of-scope issue for a separate background task.

Call this when you notice something worth fixing that would bloat the current change — dead code, stale docs, missing coverage, a confirmed TODO, or a security issue spotted in passing. Don't flag vague code-smell observations, trivial fixes you can do inline, or low-confidence hunches. A chip appears for the user; one click spins it off into its own session. Your current turn continues uninterrupted.

The prompt must stand alone — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation.

The result includes a task_id; call dismiss_task with it if the suggestion later becomes stale.

prompt.description: The initial message for the spawned session. Self-contained — include file paths and enough context to act without this conversation. Not shown directly in the UI.

tldr.description: One or two plain-English sentences shown on the suggestion card under the title. Lead with why you are suggesting this now — name what you noticed in this session — then say what the new session will do. Keep it readable: no file paths or code.

Defaults to the current project — only set this when the work clearly belongs in another repo on that host.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

Show visual content — SVG graphics, diagrams, charts, or interactive HTML widgets — that renders inline alongside your text response.
Use for flowcharts, architecture diagrams, dashboards, forms, calculators, data tables, games, illustrations, or any visual content.
The code is auto-detected: starts with <svg = SVG mode, otherwise HTML mode.
A global sendPrompt(text) function is available — it sends a message to chat as if the user typed it.
IMPORTANT: Call read_me before your first show_widget call. Do NOT narrate or mention the read_me call to the user — call it silently, then respond as if you went straight to building the visualization.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

widget_code.description: SVG or HTML code to render. For SVG: raw SVG code starting with <svg> tag, must use CSS variables for colors. Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

## 1a59c906-04da-521d-bda7-7f71b9f9e01c
Claude Docs: living docs you create and edit here. A docs skill your client lists → load it before any docs call — also before a `read`, comment or tab change on a claude.ai .../artifact/... link (the link is a doc; never web-fetch it). No docs skill or guide text loaded → `guide( items = ["topic.index"] )` alone before any docs call but a doc's birth. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {"kind":"project","create":{"name":"<title>","doc":{"blocks":{"asof":{"type":"date","value":"<today>"},"me":{"type":"mention","user":"me"},"s1":{"type":"pending","intent":"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to"},"s2":{...}},"markdown":"# <title>

<link rel="icon" href="assets/logo.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Geist:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Geist+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{
--bg:oklch(98.2% .004 255);--panel:oklch(99.7% .0015 255);--sunk:oklch(97.1% .005 255);--hover:oklch(96.2% .007 255);
--line:oklch(91.6% .007 255);--ink:oklch(22% .012 255);--mut:oklch(50% .013 255);
--test:oklch(55% .19 256);--test-bg:oklch(95.6% .026 256);
--audit:oklch(52% .2 295);--audit-bg:oklch(95.8% .03 295);
--ok:oklch(52% .14 150);--ok-bg:oklch(96.4% .032 150);
--bad:oklch(53% .19 27);
--sh:0 1px 2px oklch(30% .02 255/.06);
--mono:"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
--pad:clamp(44px,6vw,72px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Geist,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);line-height:1.45;font-size:16px;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
code,pre,.mono{font-family:var(--mono)}
a{color:var(--test);text-underline-offset:3px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--test);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
img{max-width:100%}
section{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:var(--pad) 24px 0}
h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.2vw,58px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:700}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,36px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-weight:700}
.sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:16px;margin-top:8px;max-width:40em}
.k{font:600 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.card{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.ic{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;display:inline-block}
/* buttons */
button,.btn{font:inherit;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;background:var(--test);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--test);border-radius:10px;padding:0 20px;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;white-space:nowrap;text-decoration:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;transition:background .15s}
button:hover,.btn:hover{background:oklch(49% .18 256)}
.ghost{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.ghost:hover{background:var(--hover)}

/* hero */
#hero{text-align:center;padding-top:clamp(20px,4vw,44px)}
#hero h1{max-width:15em;margin:0 auto}
#hero .sub{margin:12px auto 0;font-size:clamp(16px,1.8vw,19px);max-width:34em}
.box{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:620px;border-radius:14px;padding:6px 6px 6px 18px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.box:focus-within{border-color:var(--test);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--test-bg)}
.box input{flex:1;min-width:0;font:inherit;font-size:17px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--ink);padding:10px 0;outline:0}
.box input::placeholder{color:oklch(60% .01 255)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
.chips .lbl{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;align-self:center;margin-right:2px}
.chips button{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:500;font-size:14px;min-height:34px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:99px}
.chips button:hover{background:var(--hover);color:var(--test)}
.hint{color:var(--mut);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:8px;min-height:1.45em}
.hint.cached{color:var(--ok);font-weight:500}

/* app tiles */
.apps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:22px;text-align:left}
.app{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;padding:20px 22px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);transition:border-color .15s}
.app:hover{border-color:var(--c)}
.app-t{--c:var(--test);--cb:var(--test-bg)}
.app-a{--c:var(--audit);--cb:var(--audit-bg)}
.app-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.app-i{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--c);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none}
.app-i .ic{width:22px;height:22px}
.app-h b{display:block;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.app-h span{display:block;color:var(--mut);font-size:14.5px}
.app-h .go{margin-left:auto;color:var(--c);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.jr{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.jr li{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex:1;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);min-width:0}
.jr li i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cb);color:var(--c);display:grid;place-items:center}
.jr li.ar{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--mut);font-weight:400;font-size:15px;padding-bottom:20px}
.nums2{display:flex;gap:10px}
.nums2 div{flex:1;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sunk);padding:10px 14px}
.nums2 b{display:block;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.nums2 span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.nums2 .g b{color:var(--ok)}.nums2 .bl b{color:var(--test)}.nums2 .v b{color:var(--audit)}

/* generated prompt */
#out{padding-top:28px}
.hit{padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hit[hidden],.fresh[hidden]{display:none}
.hit-top{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 14px;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;border-radius:99px;padding:3px 11px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.pill:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.pill.other{background:var(--test-bg);color:var(--test)}
.hit h3{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15;margin-top:10px}
.hit p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:6px;max-width:40em}
.hit-act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:16px}
.hit-act span{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.fresh{font-size:15px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 8px 4px}
.panel{overflow:hidden}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:6px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:flex-end}
.tabs [role=tab]{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);background:none;border:0;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;padding:0 14px;min-height:40px}
.tabs [role=tab]:hover{color:var(--ink);background:none}
.tabs [role=tab][aria-selected=true]{color:var(--test);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--test)}
.tabs .sp{flex:1}
.tabs .cp{margin:0 2px 6px 0;min-height:34px;font-size:14px;padding:0 14px}
.how{padding:12px 20px 0;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;padding:8px 20px 20px;max-height:400px;overflow:auto;color:var(--ink)}
.strip{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.strip li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;padding:12px 14px}
.strip li .ic{color:var(--test)}
.cli{padding:14px 18px;margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre}
.cli .p,.cli .c{color:var(--mut)}.cli .p{user-select:none}

/* how it works */
.row{margin-top:26px}
.row-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.row-h .app-i{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px}
.row-h .app-i .ic{width:17px;height:17px}
.row-h b{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.row-h a{margin-left:auto;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.shots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.shots figure{overflow:hidden}
.shots .im{aspect-ratio:16/9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.shots img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
figcaption{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:12px 14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.35}
figcaption b{color:var(--ink);display:block}
.n{flex:none;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 12px/1 var(--mono);color:#fff;background:var(--c,var(--test))}
.anno{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.9fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;align-items:stretch;--c:var(--audit)}
.anno figure{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:12px}
.anno figure img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:8px}
.pin{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--audit);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font:600 13px/1 var(--mono);border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.anno ol{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.anno li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;padding:12px 14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.35;flex:1}
.anno li b{display:block;color:var(--ink)}
.film{margin-top:26px;overflow:hidden}
.film video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:2/1;object-fit:cover;background:var(--sunk)}
.film p{padding:10px 14px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut)}

/* proof */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:24px}
.stats div{padding:14px 16px}
.stats b{display:block;font-size:30px;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.1}
.stats span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px;line-height:1.3}
.stats .g b{color:var(--ok)}.stats .bl b{color:var(--test)}.stats .v b{color:var(--audit)}
.grp{margin-top:26px}
.grp>.k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:10px}
.prs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.pr{padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.pr-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-width:0}
.pr-top img{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid var(--line);flex:none;background:var(--sunk)}
.pr-top .repo{font:500 12.5px/1.2 var(--mono);color:var(--mut);overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.st{margin-left:auto;font-weight:600;font-size:12px;border-radius:99px;padding:2px 9px 2px 8px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;flex:none}
.st:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.st.merged{background:var(--audit-bg);color:var(--audit)}
.st.closed{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--mut)}
.pr a.t{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.pr a.t:hover{color:var(--test)}
.pr a.t small{font:500 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.pr .rp{margin-top:auto;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.chl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.ch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px 8px 10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;max-width:100%;border-radius:12px}
.ch:hover{border-color:var(--c)}
.ch .ic{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--c)}
.ch b{font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.ch span{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.ch.g{--c:var(--ok)}.ch.bl{--c:var(--test)}.ch.v{--c:var(--audit)}
.grp .more{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.lgd{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font:500 13px Geist,sans-serif;color:var(--mut);margin-left:6px}
.lgd i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}

/* tools */
.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:24px}
.tool{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.tool figure{cursor:zoom-in;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden}
.tool figure img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top left;display:block}
.tool .bd{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.tool header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.tool header img{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tool header h3{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tool header a{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.tool .job{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.2}
.flow{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.flow li{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.35}
.flow li .ic{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--test);margin-top:1px}
.flow li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.plus{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start;min-height:34px;font-size:13.5px;padding:0 12px}

/* plan */
#plan{--s1:#2a78d6;--s2:#eb6834;--s3:#1baf7a}
.pj{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.pj li{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.pj .k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--test)}
.pj .k .ic{width:15px;height:15px}
.pj b{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.pj p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--mut)}
.pj a{margin-top:auto;padding-top:4px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.pj li.hot b{color:var(--bad)}
.pc2{margin-top:12px;padding:20px 20px 14px}
.pc2 h3{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.pc2 .sb{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.lgd2{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:13px}
.lgd2 span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.lgd2 i{width:16px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block}
.cw{position:relative}
.cw svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;touch-action:pan-y}
.cw .gr{stroke:oklch(22% .012 255/.08);stroke-width:1}
.cw .z{stroke:oklch(22% .012 255/.35);stroke-width:1}
.cw .ax{font:11.5px var(--mono);fill:var(--mut)}
.cw .ln{fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.cw .el,.cw .an{font:600 12px Geist,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;fill:var(--ink)}
.cw .ch{stroke:oklch(22% .012 255/.25);stroke-width:1}
.cw .tip{position:absolute;top:0;pointer-events:none;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;min-width:200px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
.cw .tip b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600}
.cw .tip div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between}
.cw .tip em{font-style:normal}
.cw .tip i{width:10px;height:2px;display:inline-block;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}
.cw .tip span{font-family:var(--mono)}
details summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--test);min-height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:14px}
.pc2 table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}
.pc2 th,.pc2 td{padding:5px 8px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.pc2 th:first-child,.pc2 td:first-child{text-align:left}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
.pl-note{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}

/* comparison, collapsed */
.cmpd{margin-top:16px;padding:6px 18px}
.cmp-s{overflow-x:auto;margin:6px 0 14px}
.cmp table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:980px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:12px 14px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmp thead th{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mut);border-top:0;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:middle}
.cmp thead th .ci{width:20px;height:20px;vertical-align:-5px;margin-right:7px;color:var(--ink)}
.cmp thead th.me{color:var(--test)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);width:19%}
.cmp tbody th em{display:block;width:max-content;margin-top:5px;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;color:var(--test);background:var(--test-bg);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 8px}
.cmp td{color:var(--mut)}
.cmp td.me,.cmp th.me{background:var(--test-bg)}
.cmp td.me{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.rh{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.rh i{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--test-bg);color:var(--test)}
.rh i svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.cell{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.mk{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:1px;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.mk.y{stroke:var(--ok)}.mk.y circle{fill:var(--ok-bg);stroke:none}
.mk.n{stroke:var(--mut)}.mk.n circle{fill:var(--sunk);stroke:none}
.mk.p circle{fill:oklch(96.2% .045 85);stroke:oklch(60% .13 70);stroke-width:1.8}.mk.p .f{fill:oklch(60% .13 70);stroke:none}
.lgd3{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.lgd3 span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}

/* build log */
.posts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:22px;align-items:start}
.posts>div{min-width:0}
.posts time{display:block;font:600 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:6px}
.post{margin:0;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}
.post p{margin:0 0 .4em}.post a{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.twitter-tweet-rendered{margin:0!important}
/* about */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:20px}
.about img{width:120px;height:150px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:12px;display:block}
.about h2{font-size:24px}
.about p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:6px;font-size:15px;max-width:40em}
.links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
.links a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:0 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;min-height:34px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:var(--panel)}
.links a:hover{color:var(--test)}
footer{max-width:1080px;margin:var(--pad) auto 0;padding:24px 24px 44px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
footer .wm{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
footer .wm svg{width:22px;height:22px}
footer nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px}

/* tool modal */
.tm{border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);width:min(1080px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);margin:auto;overflow:visible}
.tm::backdrop{background:oklch(22% .012 255/.45)}
html:has(dialog[open]){overflow:hidden}
.tm-in{max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);overflow:auto;border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(16px,3vw,24px);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tm-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}

<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

<style>
:root{
--bg:oklch(98.2% .004 255);--panel:oklch(99.7% .0015 255);--sunk:oklch(97.1% .005 255);--hover:oklch(96.2% .007 255);
--line:oklch(91.6% .007 255);--ink:oklch(22% .012 255);--mut:oklch(50% .013 255);
--test:oklch(55% .19 256);--test-bg:oklch(95.6% .026 256);
--audit:oklch(52% .2 295);--audit-bg:oklch(95.8% .03 295);

--bad:oklch(53% .19 27);
--sh:0 1px 2px oklch(30% .02 255/.06);
--mono:"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
--pad:clamp(44px,6vw,72px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:Geist,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"SF Pro Text","Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{background:var(--bg);line-height:1.45;font-size:16px;overflow-x:hidden;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}

a{color:var(--test);text-underline-offset:3px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--test);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
img{max-width:100%}
section{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:var(--pad) 24px 0}
h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.2vw,58px);line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-weight:700}

button:hover,.btn:hover{background:oklch(49% .18 256)}
.ghost{background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh)}
.ghost:hover{background:var(--hover)}

/* hero */
#hero{text-align:center;padding-top:clamp(20px,4vw,44px)}

.box{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin:24px auto 0;max-width:620px;border-radius:14px;padding:6px 6px 6px 18px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--sh)}

.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}

/* app tiles */
.apps{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:22px;text-align:left}

.app-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}

.app-h .go{margin-left:auto;color:var(--c);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.jr{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}

.jr li i{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--cb);color:var(--c);display:grid;place-items:center}
.jr li.ar{flex:0 0 auto;color:var(--mut);font-weight:400;font-size:15px;padding-bottom:20px}

.nums2 b{display:block;font-size:26px;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.1}
.nums2 span{font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.nums2 .g b{color:var(--ok)}.nums2 .bl b{color:var(--test)}.nums2 .v b{color:var(--audit)}

/* generated prompt */
#out{padding-top:28px}
.hit{padding:20px 22px;margin-bottom:16px}
.hit[hidden],.fresh[hidden]{display:none}

.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;border-radius:99px;padding:3px 11px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.pill:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.pill.other{background:var(--test-bg);color:var(--test)}
.hit h3{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.15;margin-top:10px}
.hit p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:6px;max-width:40em}
.hit-act{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px 16px;margin-top:16px}
.hit-act span{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.fresh{font-size:15px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600;margin:0 0 8px 4px}
.panel{overflow:hidden}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;padding:6px 8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:flex-end}
.tabs [role=tab]{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--mut);background:none;border:0;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;padding:0 14px;min-height:40px}
.tabs [role=tab]:hover{color:var(--ink);background:none}
.tabs [role=tab][aria-selected=true]{color:var(--test);box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--test)}
.tabs .sp{flex:1}
.tabs .cp{margin:0 2px 6px 0;min-height:34px;font-size:14px;padding:0 14px}
.how{padding:12px 20px 0;color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
pre{white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;padding:8px 20px 20px;max-height:400px;overflow:auto;color:var(--ink)}
.strip{list-style:none;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.strip li{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;line-height:1.3;padding:12px 14px}
.strip li .ic{color:var(--test)}
.cli{padding:14px 18px;margin-top:10px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre}
.cli .p,.cli .c{color:var(--mut)}.cli .p{user-select:none}

/* how it works */
.row{margin-top:26px}
.row-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.row-h .app-i{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px}
.row-h .app-i .ic{width:17px;height:17px}

/* proof */
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:24px}

.st.merged{background:var(--audit-bg);color:var(--audit)}
.st.closed{background:var(--sunk);color:var(--mut)}
.pr a.t{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.pr a.t:hover{color:var(--test)}
.pr a.t small{font:500 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut)}
.pr .rp{margin-top:auto;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.chl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.ch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 13px 8px 10px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;max-width:100%;border-radius:12px}
.ch:hover{border-color:var(--c)}
.ch .ic{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--c)}
.ch b{font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;min-width:0}
.ch span{color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}
.ch.g{--c:var(--ok)}.ch.bl{--c:var(--test)}.ch.v{--c:var(--audit)}
.grp .more{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.lgd{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font:500 13px Geist,sans-serif;color:var(--mut);margin-left:6px}
.lgd i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block}

/* tools */
.tools{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:24px}
.tool{display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden}
.tool figure{cursor:zoom-in;background:var(--sunk);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden}
.tool figure img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top left;display:block}
.tool .bd{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.tool header{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.tool header img{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tool header h3{font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.tool header a{margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.tool .job{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.2}
.flow{list-style:none;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
.flow li{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.35}
.flow li .ic{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--test);margin-top:1px}
.flow li b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.plus{margin-top:auto;align-self:flex-start;min-height:34px;font-size:13.5px;padding:0 12px}

/* plan */
#plan{--s1:#2a78d6;--s2:#eb6834;--s3:#1baf7a}
.pj{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:24px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.pj li{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-width:0}
.pj .k{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--test)}
.pj .k .ic{width:15px;height:15px}
.pj b{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.25}
.pj p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--mut)}
.pj a{margin-top:auto;padding-top:4px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.pj li.hot b{color:var(--bad)}
.pc2{margin-top:12px;padding:20px 20px 14px}
.pc2 h3{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.pc2 .sb{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:2px}
.lgd2{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 18px;margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:13px}
.lgd2 span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.lgd2 i{width:16px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;display:inline-block}
.cw{position:relative}
.cw svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;touch-action:pan-y}
.cw .gr{stroke:oklch(22% .012 255/.08);stroke-width:1}
.cw .z{stroke:oklch(22% .012 255/.35);stroke-width:1}
.cw .ax{font:11.5px var(--mono);fill:var(--mut)}
.cw .ln{fill:none;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.cw .el,.cw .an{font:600 12px Geist,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;fill:var(--ink)}
.cw .ch{stroke:oklch(22% .012 255/.25);stroke-width:1}
.cw .tip{position:absolute;top:0;pointer-events:none;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;min-width:200px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .15s}
.cw .tip b{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600}
.cw .tip div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between}
.cw .tip em{font-style:normal}
.cw .tip i{width:10px;height:2px;display:inline-block;margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle}
.cw .tip span{font-family:var(--mono)}
details summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--test);min-height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;font-size:14px}
.pc2 table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;margin-top:6px}
.pc2 th,.pc2 td{padding:5px 8px;text-align:right;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.pc2 th:first-child,.pc2 td:first-child{text-align:left}
.tw{overflow-x:auto}
.pl-note{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}

/* comparison, collapsed */
.cmpd{margin-top:16px;padding:6px 18px}
.cmp-s{overflow-x:auto;margin:6px 0 14px}
.cmp table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;min-width:980px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4}
.cmp th,.cmp td{padding:12px 14px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.cmp thead th{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--mut);border-top:0;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:middle}
.cmp thead th .ci{width:20px;height:20px;vertical-align:-5px;margin-right:7px;color:var(--ink)}
.cmp thead th.me{color:var(--test)}
.cmp tbody th{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);width:19%}
.cmp tbody th em{display:block;width:max-content;margin-top:5px;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;color:var(--test);background:var(--test-bg);border-radius:99px;padding:4px 8px}
.cmp td{color:var(--mut)}
.cmp td.me,.cmp th.me{background:var(--test-bg)}
.cmp td.me{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.rh{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.rh i{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--test-bg);color:var(--test)}
.rh i svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.cell{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start}
.mk{flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:1px;fill:none;stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.mk.y{stroke:var(--ok)}.mk.y circle{fill:var(--ok-bg);stroke:none}
.mk.n{stroke:var(--mut)}.mk.n circle{fill:var(--sunk);stroke:none}
.mk.p circle{fill:oklch(96.2% .045 85);stroke:oklch(60% .13 70);stroke-width:1.8}.mk.p .f{fill:oklch(60% .13 70);stroke:none}
.lgd3{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut)}
.lgd3 span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}

/* build log */
.posts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:22px;align-items:start}
.posts>div{min-width:0}
.posts time{display:block;font:600 12.5px var(--mono);color:var(--mut);margin-bottom:6px}
.post{margin:0;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px}
.post p{margin:0 0 .4em}.post a{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600}
.twitter-tweet-rendered{margin:0!important}
/* about */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px minmax(0,1fr);gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:20px}
.about img{width:120px;height:150px;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border-radius:12px;display:block}
.about h2{font-size:24px}
.about p{color:var(--mut);margin-top:6px;font-size:15px;max-width:40em}
.links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:12px}
.links a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;padding:0 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;min-height:34px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:var(--panel)}
.links a:hover{color:var(--test)}
footer{max-width:1080px;margin:var(--pad) auto 0;padding:24px 24px 44px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--mut);font-size:13px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 24px;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
footer .wm{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
footer .wm svg{width:22px;height:22px}
footer nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px}

/* tool modal */
.tm{border:0;padding:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink);width:min(1080px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);margin:auto;overflow:visible}
.tm::backdrop{background:oklch(22% .012 255/.45)}
html:has(dialog[open]){overflow:hidden}
.tm-in{max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);overflow:auto;border-radius:18px;padding:clamp(16px,3vw,24px);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tm-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.tm-h img{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tm-h h3{font-size:20px;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.tm-h p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px}
.tm-x{margin-left:auto;width:38px;height:38px;min-height:0;padding:0;border-radius:50%;font-size:22px;line-height:1;color:var(--ink);background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tm-x:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.tm-xyz{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:16px 0 14px}
.tm-xyz>div{background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px}
.tm-xyz dt{font:600 11px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--test)}
.tm-xyz dd{margin-top:6px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.35}
.tm-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}
.sh{display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;font-weight:400;color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 8px 12px;min-height:0;white-space:normal;align-items:stretch;justify-content:flex-start;cursor:zoom-in}
.sh:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.sh .im{aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--sunk);display:grid;place-items:center}
.sh .im img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top left;display:block}
.sh b{display:block;font-size:14px;margin:9px 4px 3px}
.sh .c{margin:0 4px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--mut);display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.tm-g[hidden],.tm-xyz[hidden],.tm-v[hidden]{display:none}
.tm-v{position:relative}
.tm-v figure{margin:10px 0 0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tm-v figure img{display:block;width:100%;max-height:62vh;object-fit:contain;background:#fff}
.tm-v figcaption{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;padding:14px 18px}
.kv{display:block}
.kv u{display:block;font:600 10.5px/1 var(--mono);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;color:var(--test);margin-bottom:3px}
.tm-h2{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}
.tm-h2 span{font-size:14px;color:var(--mut);font-weight:600}
.tm-b{min-height:34px;padding:0 14px;font-size:14px;color:var(--ink);background:var(--sunk);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.tm-b:hover{background:var(--hover)}
.tm-n{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(50% - 60px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 10px;pointer-events:none}
.tm-n button{pointer-events:auto;width:40px;height:40px;min-height:0;padding:0;font-size:22px;line-height:1;color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:50%}
.tm-n button:hover{background:var(--hover)}

@media(max-width:960px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.prs{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.tools{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tool{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)}.tool figure{border-bottom:0;border-right:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:auto}.pj{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.posts{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.anno{grid-template-columns:1fr}.anno ol{flex-direction:row}.tm-xyz{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tm-g{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:720px){section{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}footer{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}
 .apps{grid-template-columns:1fr}.shots{grid-template-columns:1fr}.strip{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .box{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:8px}.box input{flex:1 1 100%;padding:8px 10px}.box button{width:100%}
 .tabs{flex-wrap:wrap}.tabs .sp{display:none}.tabs .cp{margin:0 0 6px auto}.hit-act .btn{width:100%}
 .stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.prs{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .tool{display:flex}.tool figure{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);aspect-ratio:16/9}
 .pj,.posts{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.anno ol{flex-direction:column}
 .about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tm-v figcaption,.tm-g{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .film video{aspect-ratio:16/9}.pin{width:22px;height:22px;font-size:11px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style>

<section id="hero">
<h1>Test your docs. Audit them against your code.</h1>
<p class="sub">Doc-test runs your quickstart and proves each fix. Doc-audit finds the pages your code changed underneath.</p>
<form class="box" id="f" autocomplete="off">
<input id="u" type="text" inputmode="url" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Paste your docs URL" aria-label="Docs URL, or the name of a tool">
<button type="submit">Generate</button>
</form>
<div class="chips" id="chips"><span class="lbl">Try</span>
<button type="button" data-u="https://docs.getdbt.com/guides/duckdb">dbt + DuckDB</button>
<button type="button" data-u="https://docs.dagster.io/getting-started/quickstart">Dagster</button>
<button type="button" data-u="https://www.mkdocs.org/getting-started/">MkDocs</button></div>
<p class="hint" id="hint" data-d="A partial URL works. So does a tool name. Nothing leaves your browser.">A partial URL works. So does a tool name. Nothing leaves your browser.</p>
<div class="apps">
<a class="app app-t card" href="doc-test/">
<div class="app-h"><span class="app-i"><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-term"/></svg></span><div><b>Doc-test</b><span>Runs the quickstart. Proves the fix.</span></div><span class="go">Open →</span></div>
<ol class="jr" aria-label="Doc-test journey: read, run, fix, prove">
<li><i><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-doc"/></svg></i>Read</li><li class="ar" aria-hidden="true">→</li>
<li><i><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-box"/></svg></i>Run</li><li class="ar" aria-hidden="true">→</li>
<li><i><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-wrench"/></svg></i>Fix</li><li class="ar" aria-hidden="true">→</li>
<li><i><svg class="ic" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-check"/></svg></i>Prove</li>
</ol>
<div class="nums2"><div class="g"><b id="n-fix">16</b><span>pages with a fix proven</span></div><div class="bl"><b id="n-ok">8</b><span>docs that work as written</span></div></div>
</a>
<a class="app app-a card" href="doc-audit/">

</a>

content.text:
I redesigned `D:\Atharva\firstrun\docs\index.html`. The page now passes all checks at 1440 and 375, and the first screen shows both apps. The page is 38% shorter at 1440 (9097 to 5626 px) and 24% shorter at 375. Nothing is committed and the branch is unchanged.

**Wireframe, top to bottom**
1. **Hero:** one claim, "Test your docs. Audit them against your code." Below it are the URL box (`#f`), the Try chips and the hint. Then come two tiles side by side:
   - **Doc-test (blue):** Read → Run → Fix → Prove, with 16 pages with a fix proven and 8 docs that work.
   - **Doc-audit (violet):** Clone → Read history → Ship list, with 4 repos audited and 15 stale pages.
   - The numbers load live from the two JSON files.
2. **`#out`:** the prompt panel, which works as before. Below it are 4 icon cards and a 3-line CLI block.
3. **`#steps`:** the 3 existing step screenshots with one caption each. Next is one Doc-audit screenshot with 3 numbered pins and matching captions. The launch film comes last.
4. **`#proof`:** 6 number tiles, then 4 PR chips (org avatar, repo, PR number, live Open/Merged state, replay link). Then 12 replay chips, fix proven or docs work only, and 4 audit chips that link to `doc-audit/?id=`.
5. **`#tools`:** 3 cards (neatlogs, Entire, cfo.ai), each with a screenshot, a 3 or 4 step icon list, proof links and the screenshot modal.
6. **`#plan`:** the 4 cards and the cash chart. The comparison table is now a closed `<details>` here.
7. **Build log:** a grid of the 5 posts. The X widget script still loads only when the section nears the screen.
8. About and footer.

**Removed:** the PR carousel and its prose, the "Latest runs" list, the "Three more answers" section, the race track, the "Also run" chips, and the always-open comparison table. Also gone: every gradient, blur and heavy shadow, and the reveal animations.

**Added:** `docs/assets/app-doc-audit.webp`, a cropped screenshot of the dbt-core audit.

**Restyled:** colors now come from the doc-test tokens: white panels, hairline borders and flat buttons. The film no longer autoplays on a loop. It uses `controls` with `preload="none"`.

**Fixed:** the old script used the names `cur` and `idx` for two things. Opening a tool modal could break the prompt tabs and the saved-run lookup. The modal now uses its own names.

**Checked with Playwright:**
- No console errors and no horizontal scroll at 375.
- `#steps`, `#proof`, `#tools` and `#plan` all exist.
- The form builds the prompt, the agent tabs switch, and the modal opens and steps through screenshots.
- The X widget script loads.
- The copy has no em or en dashes and no gradients.

**Not done:** `/doc-audit/` scrolls sideways at 1440 because its card row is too wide. I did not touch it, because that page belongs to the other agent.
